issue.title: Fix wait strategy definition

repository.name: testcontainers-java
repository.description: Testcontainers is a Java library that supports JUnit tests, providing lightweight, throwaway instances of common databases, Selenium web browsers, or anything else that can run in a Docker container.

issue.body:
Currently, `waitingFor` takes precedence over `setWaitStrategy`. This was introduced with ContainerDef in 1dba8d1. This commit  uses `waitStrategy` defined in GenericContainer for both methods `waitingFor` and `setWaitStrategy`.

Fixes #8578
